<section class="juice-option" markdown="1">

<p class="juice-tag">Recommended</p>

## Juice Desktop

The kernel + web interface.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://juiceos.org/install-desktop.sh | sh
```

[Read the script]({{ '/install-desktop.sh' | relative_url }}) &middot; [Source](https://github.com/daios-ai/juice-ui)

</section>

<section class="juice-option" markdown="1">

## Juice Kernel

The kernel alone, for servers and command-line use.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://juiceos.org/install.sh | sh
```

[Read the script]({{ '/install.sh' | relative_url }}) &middot; [Getting started]({{ '/juice/getting-started.html' | relative_url }}) &middot; [Configuration]({{ '/juice/reference/config.html' | relative_url }})

</section>

## Optional dependencies

Both downloads run without these. Each one switches on part of the kernel's standard library.

- **[Ollama](https://ollama.com) with a chat model.** Language-model calls need one. The default is `gemma4:26b`.
- **[Ollama](https://ollama.com) with an embedding model.** Search uses one to match by meaning. The default is `nomic-embed-text`.
- **[TinyGo](https://tinygo.org).** The WebAssembly compiler needs it to build Wasm programs.

You can name other models in the [configuration]({{ '/juice/reference/config.html' | relative_url }}).
